Raspberry Pi 5 Pimoroni Nvme Case v1

https://makerworld.com/de/models/401206-raspberry-pi-5-pimoroni-nvme-case-v1?from=search#profileId-304588

This is a hex case for the Raspberry Pi 5 with the Pimoroni nvme base attached to it. I added the hex pattern for ventilation and also there is a power button on the back of the case. The case snaps together nicely. Make sure to print 100% infill, no rafts required, no brims, no supports.

 

Note: DO NOT use with an SD card installed, make sure to take it out prior to installation.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 3 walls, 100% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 3
- Infill: 100%
- Filament: PLA (#00AE42)
